about_the_game:
BREAK IN THE BUSINESS, BLACK OUT THE WITNESS

Noirmancer is a single-player first-person stealth game where you play a supernatural vigilante who breaks into company buildings, steals their confidential documents, stumbles upon big scoops, and creates trouble.

INFILTRATE, INVESTIGATE, ESCAPE

Mission-based gameplay turns you loose in an area with an objective and your collection of abilities. You are you free to explore how you like and use your abilities to remain undetected, overcome obstacles, and thoroughly loot the place.

RUIN DAYS

During these missions you encounter the back-door dealings of important people, and can discover ways to create serious trouble.

FEATURES

  • Stealth-oriented gameplay. Not a combat game with stealth elements.

  • Unique approach to stealth failure; Guards don't give up looking for you, instead you have to erase their memories while they're still vulnerable. No waiting in a corner until you get to play the game again.

  • 9 supernatural abilities for you to use how you see fit.

  • A campaign of levels each with their own story to uncover and surprises to find.

short_description: You are a super-powered vigilante sneak in a noir-infused mega-metropolis. Turn to mist, shrink under obstacles, swim in air, and black-out guards with a snap of your fingers. Steal secrets, sabotage their operations, and erase guards' memories to remain undetected. Evade the shadows hunting you.
